Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
library.service.AuthService
public class AuthService extends Object
Authentication service: sign up, sign in, role detection and password hashing.

Role rule: an email of the form <name>.admin@<domain> (for example usman.admin@library.com) is an ADMIN/Librarian; every other valid email is a STUDENT. Admin sign-up additionally requires the admin access code "LIB-ADMIN-2026". Passwords are stored only as SHA-256 hashes. A student sign-up automatically creates (or links to) a library Member record.

Author:
Usman
